products.name: SenseTime SenseChat
products.note: Chinese multimodal LLM; computer vision integration; cross-border data review advised

profile_text.body:
SenseTime is a Chinese AI company that builds large language models and cloud infrastructure for enterprise AI adoption. Its core offerings include SenseNova, described as a native multimodal large language model platform, and SenseCore, an AI cloud infrastructure service the company positions as the foundation for enterprise digital transformation. The company describes itself as grounded in academic research and focused on translating that research into scalable, real-world applications across multiple industries.

According to IDC's "China AI Software Market Semi-Annual Tracker, 2025 H2" report, cited by SenseTime on its own site, the company has led China's Vision AI market share for ten consecutive years. The site tracks one product under SenseTime's name, SenseTime SenseChat, categorized as a Chinese multimodal large language model with computer vision integration, with a note that cross-border data review is advised for users outside China. No litigation, MCP server registrations, or SEC or patent filings appear in the held facts.
